nodes.name: intro
dialogues: Hi, this is a RPG built by
Giulia Filicicchia
Giusto Baiamonte
Samuele Morreale
as project for ISS exam.
During the game you can fight enemies
and level up by defeating them.
You can also learn more Moves from a NPC.
You can interact with him when you're near him
and then by pressing E
If you lose only once, it's Game Over.
Don't worry, you can save your game by pressing Esc
However, pay attention to the plot, because
your choices will influence the outcome
Have fun
PS. you cannot see your stats yet :(
But now just enjoy The Cycle :)

choices.text: Let's go
What? And how can i know how strong I am?

dialogues: Just check your Job.java file
Across the world are surging hostile creatures,
like they were hid underground and are going out
only now.
But when someone checked the underground,
they didn't find anything at all.
These hostile creatures attack everyone at sight
and don't even speak.

choices.text: Look for them and kill them all

nodes.name: map1_end
dialogues: You defeated all the enemies in this area.
Perhaps you have to move onto the next area

choices.text: Think about the battle you had here
Go to the next area

nodes.name: map1_yapping
dialogues: You did well.
This is the first area though.
You couldn't help but notice you felt a familiar
feelings when battling, like you knew what to do.
Moreover, during the fight you are pretty silent
and your only thought is slaying every enemy ahead of you.

choices.text: Go to the next area

nodes.name: map2_start
dialogues: Finally you're in the second area.
You feel the enemies are stronger here, but
you think you can do it.
You heard from someone those enemies started to
tear up an area after they killed everyone.
Perhaps they have a goal in mind.

choices.text: Whatever. You only need to kill them, right?
Fight them and study their behavior

nodes.name: map2_force
dialogues: You did it.

choices.text: Advance to the next area

nodes.name: map2_truth
dialogues: You tried to study your enemy's behavior.
Ultimately you failed.
You couldn't understand a thing of them.
Perhaps it's due to the fact there's nothing
to get about 'em.
Maybe they just enjoy destruction, feeling
the touch of their foes' blood,
releasing what they feel
by ravaging every area they step in...

choices.text: Another reason to stop them. Go to the next area
They're... like us?

nodes.name: map2_deep_thinking
dialogues: Why would you think they're similar to you?
You're supposed to be the heroes who vanquish
the enemies and save innocent lives
from their brutality.
A question comes at your minds:
Why did you even start traveling this world
and kill monsters?

choices.text: To repent this threat.
You don't know.
You just like fighting

nodes.name: map3_start_no_doubt
dialogues: You know it: this is the last area.
You fought bravely and killed all enemies.
All battles trained you and now you're ready
to face the last battle.
But before you have to wipe another bunch
of monsters.

choices.text: Go on. Time to end this

nodes.name: destruction_intro_no_doubt
dialogues: DESTRUCTION.
«I knew you would've done 'til the end.»
The voice echoes in the air. It's clear and firm,
but they're not shouting. Instead, they're calm.
Like they're announcing a truth they foresaw
from the beginning.
«Destruction is a constant in this world and it's
unstoppable.»
«And at the end, when only I stand alone, I'll
have nothing to but destroy this body of mine.»

choices.text: Fight them and end all this no-sense!
Did they say they foresaw this outcome?

nodes.name: destruction_fight_no_doubt
dialogues: The party won.
They lost.

choices.text: What's happening?

nodes.name: creation_arrival_no_doubt
dialogues: CREATION:
«You did well.»
«You managed to defeat Destruction.»
The voice is clear and kind, but seems kinda apathetic.
«But in a world without Destruction
there's nothing to balance this power of mine.»
«Endless creation... This is what I am.»
«And it can't be stopped.»
«A new world will be created and this one be overridden.»
Clouds are swirling upon you and
you can catch a glimpse of a new world.

choices.text: At the end this is a Game Over
You can't let this! Fight the Creation too

nodes.name: destruction_and_creation_defeated_no_doubt
dialogues: At the end the Creation lost.
Now no Destruction thing will threaten this world
Nor there will be a Creation force spiraling out
of control and trying to override this world.
But when the universe will reach its Heat Death
there will be none to reshape it.
Everything will be ended. After only the void
Was this the right choice?

choices.text: Do you win?

nodes.name: destruction_from_no_doubt_branching
dialogues: DESTRUCTION:
«Why do you think you're so strong?»
«Why do you think only you managed to
defeat my creations?»
«YOU HAVE the Destruction in you,
YOU HAVE the same power of me and the monsters
you killed.»
«I created you and left you in this world.»
«The only difference between you and those monsters
is you're smart enough to be aware of your existence»
«You slayed everything in your path, WITHOUT
ASKING QUESTIONS, just like, even if you
were unaware, you sought DESTRUCTION.»
«Now come on, there's only one way. Kill me
if you can and then ravage this world by yourself.»

choices.text: You fight, even knowing your powers come from Destruction
Object your true nature

nodes.name: surrend_to_destruction_no_doubt
dialogues: If your power comes from DESTRUCTION,
if you're fated to destroy everything,
then you understand there can be one way out.
At the end you could save no one, nothing
but your own freedom. Like the Stoic Seneca
you accepted death to achieve release from
every constraint.
YOU SURRENDERED TO DESTRUCTION

choices.text: GAME OVER

choices.text: This will be the last world ever.
EMBRACE DESTRUCTION!

nodes.name: self_annihilation
dialogues: After all this efforts, all you can get
is the survival of this world 'til it meets
its natural end.
Since this is the last chance for the world,
it should'nt be wasted.
You all can feel the instincts these battles
awakened in you. They're the proof of the
DESTRUCTION's words truthfulness.
The pain you felt due to your wounds
made you stronger. Your brains are starting
to associate PAIN = MORE POWER
and MORE POWER = MORE PLEASURE
MORE PAIN = MORE PLEASURE?
This thought scares you.
You know you can't give up to it.
There are two choices.
Hid together away from the civilized world
surviving until your natural death. This
way you all will never experience a normal life.
Or ensure the peace for this world by
choosing death now.
Regardless of your choice,
it'll make you all suffer...

choices.text: Only the Players can now the end

nodes.name: total_annihilation
dialogues: You are indeed beasts.
You embraced your true nature and ended
up killing everyone and destroying
everything but yourselves.
And then that sudden urge.
What choice could you possibly have?
Amidst the void you can do nothing but
destroying yourselves.
Since you destroyed creation,
there will be no new world.

nodes.name: surrend_to_creation
dialogues: The party understood they cannot oppose
a natural force which is a constant in the world.
They let Creation erase their world with a new one.
However, in this world there will be Destruction.
But those who were dwelling in the old world
won't face the same. They will never appear again
like they are now.
YOU SURREND TO CREATION

choices.text: GAME OVER

dialogues: You don't know.
You don't even know why this little adventure of yours
started. Here's the question: What do you feel?
The answer will change everything. Keep in mind you
choose your outcome.
You
can
be
everything
you

choices.text: Heroes. This sounds good

nodes.name: nothingness
dialogues: You're engulfed by questions.
Yet you have no answers.
Monsters surround you, but, if you don't even know
why are you fighting, what's the point of doing it?
at the end you'd feel nothingness.
Perhaps this is your Stoic death.
Now you're free from doubt.

nodes.name: map3_start_hard_doubt
dialogues: Did you say you like fighting?
These are no entertaining fights.
You're putting your own lives on the edge
to kill monsters no one know wherever
they come from.
You can only end up destroying or
being destroyed.
If this is what you enjoy in life
you all are quite messed up.
The thought of being savages yourselves
like your foes
scares you. But there's more than
meets the eye.
Fighting everyone, everything until
someone strongerkills you sounds not
exciting, but releasing.
You'd have nothing to worry.
Ultimately the only difference between the Party
and the Enemies is the former
uses intellect to fight,
the latter seems to attack RandomLy.
If the Party embraces this twisted side of them,
they only would have to worry about winning.
No more choices,
no more ethics.
Just their instinct and their intellect to satisfy
their bloodthirst.
These thoughts put you all to the edge,
you all start feeling a big headache.
When did those monsters surround you?
Did you all space out so much even
these brainless monsters noticed you?
It seems it's time to choose...

choices.text: You don't know how all of this started
There's no better moment to embrace Destruction than now

choices.text: DO THEY WANT TO STOP YAPPING? KILL THEM!

nodes.name: destruction_fight_twisted
dialogues: You all are enjoying this bloody feast.
Even DESTRUCTION themself
wasn't a match for you. Outside of battle
you all lost reason.
You all can think clearly only while fighting.
Of course, the only thought can cross
your lost minds can be fighting at your best
because there would be no fun
in holding back.

choices.text: YES! GIVE US MORE FOES!

nodes.name: creation_defeat_twisted
dialogues: What would even be the point of listening all
of that boring talks?
You already defeated all the minions in all area.
Now you just defeated the big shots.
There's no more foe for you.
You all feel outraged. What does mean
"No more foe for you?"
Wait. Who are you talking to? You really went insane.

choices.text: No more foes... Unless you make the world your foe!
